title: MES job batch envelope
description: Response of POST /api/v1/jobs/batch/ (202) and GET /api/v1/job-batches/{batch_id}/. One ordinary job per uploaded file, in upload order; each file's result is served by GET /api/v1/jobs/{job_id}/result/. The batch status is computed from the jobs: pending (all pending), running (any running, or pending mixed with finished), succeeded (all succeeded), failed (all failed) or partial (all finished, some failed). The XML representation (mes-job-batch.xsd) carries the same content.

index.description: Position of the file in the upload, starting at 0.
